scripts.vercel-build: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; FLUTTER_VERSION="${FLUTTER_VERSION:-3.41.6}"; FLUTTER_SDK_DIR="${FLUTTER_SDK_DIR:-.flutter-sdk}"; if [[ ! -d "$FLUTTER_SDK_DIR" ]]; then curl -fsSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_${FLUTTER_VERSION}-stable.tar.xz" -o flutter.tar.xz; mkdir -p "$FLUTTER_SDK_DIR"; tar xf flutter.tar.xz -C "$FLUTTER_SDK_DIR" --strip-components=1; rm flutter.tar.xz; fi; export PATH="$PWD/$FLUTTER_SDK_DIR/bin:$PATH"; export CI=true; flutter --version; flutter config --enable-web; flutter pub get; flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run'
